verified_facts.text: The resort is set at Nikadori in the Hirara area of Miyakojima.
verified_facts.excerpt: integrated into the captivating landscape of Nikadori-1068-1 Hirara, Miyakojima

verified_facts.text: The resort buildings trace the curve of the shoreline.
verified_facts.excerpt: our architecturally thoughtful resort buildings elegantly trace the curve of the shoreline

verified_facts.text: The retreat is inspired by modern Japanese minimalism and shaped by the culture of the Ryukyu Islands.
verified_facts.excerpt: A retreat shaped by the soul of the Ryukyu Islands, crafted from nature and inspired by modern Japanese minimalism

verified_facts.text: KAMII House is a two-bedroom villa on the tip of the resort's peninsula.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched on the tip of the resort's secluded peninsula, KAMII House is a two bedroom villa with one King and two Twins.

verified_facts.text: UPRA House is a two-bedroom villa with a private pool and indoor and outdoor dining including a BBQ area.
verified_facts.excerpt: UPRA House is a two bedroom villa with one King and two Twins, anchored by a private pool. Indoor and outdoor dining including a BBQ area invite effortless gatherings

verified_facts.text: The Beachfront Villa opens directly onto the sand and the ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Where the sand meets your doorstep, the Beachfront Villa blends indoor luxury with open-air calm, connecting you directly to the ocean

verified_facts.text: Nagi, named for the calm of the sea, serves Italian cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Named for the calm of the sea, Nagi brings authentic Italian cuisine

verified_facts.text: Choma offers four expressions of Japanese cuisine beside the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choma invites guests to explore four refined expressions of Japanese cuisine, set beside the vivid blue sea of Miyakojima.

verified_facts.text: Choma Bar is a quiet bar whose cocktails are inspired by the stories of Miyako's eight islands.
verified_facts.excerpt: A quiet bar inspired by the stories of Miyako’s eight islands, where each cocktail captures the spirit of the sea, land, and life of the islands

verified_facts.text: Asaya Spa rituals are rooted in the island's herbs and oils and the five elements.
verified_facts.excerpt: Journey inward at Asaya Spa. Rooted in the island’s herbs, oils, and the rhythm of the five elements

verified_facts.text: Guests can step from the beach in front of the resort to go SUP, kayaking and snorkeling.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Step from the beach in front of the resort and into Miyako Blue.

SUP, kayaking, and snorkeling invite you to experience the sea at your own pace.

verified_facts.text: Guests can join the resort's efforts to protect Miyakojima's native horses, of which fewer than 50 remain.
verified_facts.excerpt: Miyakojima’s native horses are a beloved symbol of the island, but fewer than 50 remain in the world. Join our efforts to ensure their survival

verified_facts.text: Guests can try adan weaving, a local craft using the native Adan tree.
verified_facts.excerpt: The native Adan tree is a crucial material for islanders, who for generations have used it to weave tools and baskets. Try your hand at adan weaving

verified_facts.text: Guests can unwind in a private cabana by the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind in a private cabana at Rosewood Miyakojima
